scientific_integrity: Exact Petrukhin Definition 2.6 semantics used; proof by structural induction plus sixteen separating pointed model pairs; the script independently checks finite cases. Not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Explicit formula nondefinability for the propositional plus all b/n-indexed modalities signature on universal S5 frames. Languages with primitive box/diamond and nonstandard model translations are not covered. Finite experiments do not prove the general theorem.
title: Joint nondefinability of sixteen Belnapian essence and accident modalities
